bglab-scene-rooftop: An empty rooftop at night, no people. Hand-painted anime film background of a small apartment rooftop above a rain-washed city. At the right edge a rusty water tank and a warm amber lamp over a small door, and beyond the railing the city at night with a distant elevated train crossing on a rail line. Faint rose and cyan reflections on the wet surfaces, muted graphite palette with small amber accents. An empty rooftop with nobody on it. Fixed eye-level camera, calm and quiet, hand-painted cel anime film background art. No text, no signs, no logos, no characters, no people, no figures.
